## Plan

Approach — one new module owns the foreign-vocabulary surface
(CC1: `parse` is the one grammar; the four lifts are
format-parameterised over the landed machinery):

1. `crates/hh-bundle/src/foreign.rs` (new): `pub enum ForeignFormat`
   — the closed sum `{harbor_trial_dir, harbor_job_dir,
   interchange_trajectory, swebench_submission, inspect_eval_log,
   in_toto_bundle, telemetry_trace}` with `as_str`/`parse`/
   `lifts()`/`exports()`. Per-format claim extraction
   (`lift_claims`) + per-format export arms (`export_*`), plus the
   private helpers (RFC-4648 base64 for DSSE envelopes; RFC-3339 →
   unix-nanos for OTLP span times; digest-derived trace/span ids).
   Format references recorded per variant (upstream URL + fetch date).
2. `import.rs`: `lift_foreign(format: ForeignFormat)` — typed at the
   API; `FOREIGN_FORMATS` retired in favour of the enum's liftable
   set (`interchange_trajectory` stays unliftable — OQ-030/ADR-0213
   status quo → typed `ForeignDirectionRefused`, never guessed).
   After the generic file lift, `foreign::lift_claims` mints the
   format's typed claims + name_bindings + mapping_loss rows (all
   `unverified` provenance).
3. `export.rs`: `export_target` gains the four arms dispatching on
   `ForeignFormat::parse`; every emitted field is one the format
   carries (no claim the format cannot carry); unshipped members keep
   the `untyped_slot`/`no_slot` loss sweep.
4. `error.rs`: `ForeignDirectionRefused{format, direction}` — a known
   format asked the wrong way is a typed refusal, not `FormatUnknown`.
5. `lib.rs`: `pub mod foreign` + `ForeignFormat` re-export.
6. `hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs`: `kernel_import_foreign` parses to the
   typed format (`Refused{FormatUnknown}` on miss — unchanged wire
   refusal).
7. Fixtures: `crates/hh-bundle/fixtures/foreign/<format>/` — one small
   committed sample per format + `PROVENANCE.md` (upstream URL, fetch
   date 2026-10-22, capture_kind stand-in — hand-authored per the cited
   schema).
8. Records: DF-S4.2-2 → DONE (dated evidence); ADR-0370 (the four
   claim-set rulings + the `import` grammar note — the ticket's
   "four lifts … hosted unverified bundles" admits `in_toto_bundle`/
   `telemetry_trace` lifts beyond the spec's printed import set;
   additive, CC8); reports/2026-10-22 ADR-trigger dispositions
   (0292/0293/0294/0308); COVERAGE_MATRIX dated note on R-2.10.5
   (+ R-2.10.3/R-2.9.3 progress notes; verdicts unchanged — R4.16's
   accounting).

Direction rulings (the claim-set rulings DF-S4.2-2 assigns this
ticket):

- `swebench_submission` — lift+export. Lift: `*.jsonl` prediction rows
  → `swebench.instance:<id>` claims {model, patch digest}, model names
  → name_bindings; unparseable lines → loss rows. Export:
  `predictions.jsonl` per subject run (instance ← `task_ref`/run id,
  patch ← payload `patch`/`diff` scan else `""` + `no_slot` loss) +
  `manifest.json` + `digests.json`.
- `inspect_eval_log` — lift+export (the `.json` spelling; `.eval` zip
  carrier is a transport the artefact documents). Lift: header
  (version/status/eval.task/model) + `results.scores`/`samples` digests
  → `inspect.*` claims; `plan`/`stats`/`reductions`/sample transcripts
  → `untyped_slot` losses. Export: `eval_log.json` (version 2; scores
  from `verification.validator.verdict`/`measurement.metric.emitted`
  events; samples = per-run minimal rows) + digests.
- `in_toto_bundle` — lift+export. Lift: `*.intoto.jsonl` DSSE envelope
  lines → decoded `intoto.subject:*`/`intoto.predicate:*`/
  `intoto.signature` claims — signatures counted, NEVER verified
  (no trust roots; `unverified` authority). Export:
  `<id>.intoto.jsonl` — one unsigned DSSE envelope, subject = bundle +
  member digests, `signatures: []` + `no_slot` loss (signing is
  `attest()`'s concern — a lowering never fabricates a signature).
- `telemetry_trace` — lift+export. Lift: `resourceSpans` →
  `otel.service:*`/`otel.trace:*`/`otel.span_count` claims; span
  attributes/events/links → `narrowed` loss. Export: `traces.json`
  OTLP — one span per ledger event (deterministic digest-derived ids;
  event payloads narrow to span attributes — the span stream cannot
  re-derive the event set, loss row says so).

"Symmetric" = the format admits both directions here → all four
round-trip export→import (byte-stable: artefact files preserved
verbatim as `foreign:` members at equal content addresses, format
claims re-derived equal). Claim-level asymmetries (in-toto's
signature channel, telemetry's narrowing) are recorded in each
format's loss record — no direction is silent.
